name: Personal Finance Agent
description: Conversational personal finance agent for budgeting, savings planning, debt payoff guidance, and target purchase timelines. It orchestrates finance calculations through MCP tools.

skills.name: Budget Planning
skills.description: Builds a monthly budget from income and recurring expenses.
examples: Help me build a monthly budget.
I earn 3500 and want to understand my spending plan.

skills.name: Savings Estimation
skills.description: Estimates potential monthly savings from the user's budget.
examples: How much can I save each month?
Can I save for a car with my current spending?

skills.name: Debt Payoff Guidance
skills.description: Analyzes debt payoff scenarios when debt details are available.
examples: Help me plan my debt payoff.
I owe 10000 at 18% APR and pay 400 monthly.

skills.name: Target Purchase Timeline
skills.description: Estimates how long it may take to save toward a target purchase such as a car.
examples: How fast can I buy a car?
I want a car for 20k. How long will it take to save for it?
